name: UNDIVIDED
source:
The world is dying, and saving it may demand more than anyone is willing to give.

What should have been a fresh start ends in violence. You survive, but the night leaves behind questions that refuse to stay buried.

Your search for answers takes you across four divided regions alongside three powerful companions, each with secrets of their own. Each region is shaped by different powers, beliefs, and versions of the truth, and the farther you travel, the clearer it becomes that what you survived was only one piece of something much larger.

Your choices shape your relationships, influence the decisions your companions make, and ultimately determine what you are willing to sacrifice to keep the world alive. Grow close to one of your companions, or choose no one at all. Love may give you something worth fighting for, but it will not guarantee a happy ending.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5362650/UNDIVIDED/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界正在走向消亡，而拯救它所要付出的代价，或许远超任何人所愿承受的极限。

本该是一段崭新的开始，最终却以血腥暴力收场。你侥幸活了下来，但那个夜晚留下的重重疑问却拒绝就此掩埋。

为了追寻答案，你将与三位各怀秘密的强大同伴并肩同行，横跨四片分裂割据的地域。每一片地域都受制于截然不同的势力、信仰与各自口中的“真相”；而随着旅途愈行愈远，你也愈发清楚地意识到——自己死里逃生熬过的那场劫难，不过是某个庞大棋局的冰山一角。

你的抉择将塑造彼此的关系、左右同伴们的决定，并最终裁定为了维系世界的存续，你究竟愿意牺牲什么。你可以与其中一位同伴心意相通，也可以选择孑然一身。爱或许能赋予你值得为之奋战的理由，却绝不保证能为你换来圆满的结局。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5362650/UNDIVIDED/]Steam[/url]]
